Welcome to ShelfPal Simplified inventory, tracking and reminders. We help you make the most of your food, grocery items, and products which you may not need that could otherwise go to waste. Next
Capture & Forget Adding items is easy and improving With the help of AI, ShelfPal automatically reads your item name, category and expiry information, making it easy for you to save items. Next
Always Know What's Next Stay organized and get reminders From helpful filters, to color coded items by urgency and status, to setting custom reminders. Continue
Ready to Get Started? Grant permissions to make the most of ShelfPal To easily add items and get reminders, please grant ShelfPal Camera and Notification access. This can be changed at anytime in Settings. Start Tracking Now
